note: Repository-side documented settings for Cloudflare Workers Builds. Cloudflare dashboard owns the actual Git integration, secrets, and build triggers.
previewBuilds: disabled until production validated; if enabled later use separate dev worker, never a production custom domain
managedAuthentication: Cloudflare Workers Builds generates an API token upon Git connection; do not store expiring Wrangler OAuth tokens or CircleCI credentials
productionSmokeTest: Worker's live corporate homepage must contain 'Move business' and 'Spine InnovTech'

releaseTrigger.note: Trigger production Cloudflare Workers Builds through the GitHub main-branch push. No DNS or worker-name changes.
